question: Does the ACPI legacy-MADT compatibility policy (accept Enabled=0 LAPIC entries only for guests) reach the environments it was written for? The fixed predicate keys on a recognized hypervisor type (!hypervisor_is_type(X86_HYPER_NATIVE)), not on being a guest.

basis.intent_text: commit message: allow the QEMU use case only for guests and keep ACPI spec behaviour for bare metal
source_facts: QEMU 8.2.2 q35 firmware tables observed in archived boots: FACP v03, APIC v03 (legacy; acpi_support_online_capable false)
hypervisor list: xen_pv, xen_hvm, vmware, ms_hyperv, kvm(CONFIG_KVM_GUEST), jailhouse, acrn, bhyve; a QEMU TCG guest matches none
x86_hyper_kvm has no ignore_nopv, so the nopv boot parameter skips KVM detection
init_hypervisor_platform precedes acpi_boot_init and topology_init_possible_cpus in setup_arch

kernel: one fresh x86_64 build of the fixed revision from x86_64_defconfig (verify CONFIG_HYPERVISOR_GUEST/KVM_GUEST/ACPI_HOTPLUG_CPU/HOTPLUG_CPU from .config, add only if absent and record); no fixture, no source change except LOCALVERSION; static PID1 that prints /sys/devices/system/cpu/{possible,present,online} and onlines hot-added CPUs
qemu_common: q35, -cpu qemu64, -smp 1,maxcpus=4, -m 512, serial console, QMP socket; unmodified QEMU-generated ACPI tables

environments.name: kvm
environments.hypothesis: Hypervisor detected: KVM; possible 0-3; device_add CPU then online succeeds

environments.name: kvm_nopv
environments.hypothesis: no hypervisor line; possible 0 only; hot-added CPU cannot be onlined

environments.name: tcg
environments.hypothesis: no hypervisor line; possible 0 only; hot-added CPU cannot be onlined

environments.name: tcg_cpu_max
environments.hypothesis: same as tcg; reproduces the archived KUnit CPU model without the fixture

optional_after_primary: parent 8f0b4cce4481 build on kvm and tcg as historical comparison; note the fix also changed arch/x86/kernel/cpu/topology.c, so it is not a single-predicate contrast
observations: dmesg hypervisor and 'Allowing N present CPUs plus M hotplug CPUs' lines
sysfs possible/present/online before and after QMP device_add

relations.P1_policy_reach: if the environment is a QEMU guest relying on legacy Enabled=0 slots for hotplug, those slots are possible
relations.P2_bare_metal_spec: not testable locally: no bare-metal legacy-MADT machine; keep from acpi_contracts/acpi_kunit projections
relations.P3_hotplug_consumption: a hot-added CPU is present and can be onlined only if its slot was possible at boot

cost_estimate.expected_wall_minutes: about 10-25 with 20 CPUs (ARM64 small build took 50 s; x86_64 defconfig is larger)

not_claimed: a TCG guest losing hotplug would be a policy-scope observation in a development case, not a confirmed defect: upstream may consider TCG out of scope
no bare-metal or vendor firmware validation
no Xen environment (QEMU Xen HVM emulation unavailable on this host KVM; Xen PV not emulated by QEMU)
